name: Shandong Wit Dyne Health Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Wit Dyne Health Co.,Ltd. engages in the pharmaceutical business in China. Its medical products include azithromycin granules, glycyrrhizin zinc granules, compound calcium carbonate, vitamin AD drops, iprastat tablets, valsartan hydrochlorothiazide gel, roxithromycin, rosiglitazone tartrate tablets, and glimepiride tablets. The company also provides dextran iron granules, oral rehydration salts, montmorillonite powder, azithromycin granules, rifaximin dry suspension, and dimercaptosuccinic acid capsules.
